UPDATE platform.jobs
            SET status = 'queued',
                locked_at = NULL,
                locked_by = NULL,
                last_error = 'verrou expiré : travail repris, l''essai déjà compté n''est pas rendu'
          WHERE queue = $1
            AND status = 'running'
            AND locked_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $2)
